story: An icon of the skies, the Long Tailed Nightjar (Caprimulgus climacurus) is a species from the Caprimulgidae family. It thrives in Savanna; open habitats; arid semi-deserts; shrubland; and dry woodland, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Long Tailed Nightjar is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Long Tailed Nightjar helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Long Tailed Nightjar, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
